skill_name.description: The skill you loaded for this review, named exactly as it is registered.

notes.description: Anything about the run itself rather than the code: a skill that would not load, a reference file it expected and could not find, coverage you could not reach.

skill_name.description: Same value as the top-level skill_name.

file.description: Repo-relative path, no leading slash. When a finding's root cause sits in a file the diff does not touch, point at the root cause rather than at the changed line that exposed it.

line.description: The single most specific line the finding is about.

end_line.description: Only for a genuine multi-line range.

in_diff.description: False when this line is not part of the reviewed diff.

category.description: Short kebab-case kind, e.g. sql-injection, duplicated-code, missing-requirement, scope-creep.
